result.root_cause: Two defects in modal-body.jsx: (1) closeQuickView() called inside handleAddToCart unmounted ProductView before it could open the AddToCartModal confirmation; (2) Missing controlledVariationValues prop meant ProductView's useDerivedProduct couldn't track variant selection in modal context (no URL params available), causing validateOrderability to silently reject Add to Cart clicks.
result.fix_summary: Replaced closeQuickView() in handleAddToCart with a useEffect watching useAddToCartModalContext().isOpen. Added controlled variation state (useState + onVariationChange callback) passed to ProductView via controlledVariationValues and onVariationChange props.
